<function name="SetNetworkedAngle" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>
<deprecated>You should use <page>Entity:SetNWAngle</page> instead.</deprecated>

Sets a networked angle value at specified index on the entity.

The value then can be accessed with <page>Entity:GetNetworkedAngle</page> both from client and server.

<note>Running this function clientside will only set it clientside for the client it is called on.</note>
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="key" type="string">The key to associate the value with</arg>
		<arg name="value" type="Angle" default="Angle( 0, 0, 0 )">The value to set</arg>
	</args>
</function>
